page_title: CEL 1-2 RAY | Celta Vigo v Rayo Vallecano 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) tries to nod in the rebound, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.

90+5' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla makes a nice save.
90+4' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Pulido had an easy-decision to make.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
89' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes.
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) for Jorge de Frutos.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch for Pablo Duran.
84' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Marcos Alonso and he is replaced by Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo).
81' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
79' Here is a change. Williot Swedberg is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo).
79' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mihailo Ristic.
76' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
73' A cooling break is underway.
73' The attendance for today's match is 21482.
72' The shot by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Augusto Batalla.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Unai Lopez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano).
69' Celta Vigo fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) replaces Fernando Lopez.
68' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
68' What was Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
67' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

67' He should have scored! Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Celta Vigo force a corner. They send men into the box.
67' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

66' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
65' A cross from a corner kick by Celta Vigo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
61' Substitution. Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pacha walks off.
60' Substitution. Adrian Embarba walks off the pitch and Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as a substitute.
60' Inigo Perez decides to make a substitution. Oscar Valentin will be replaced by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).
57' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
57' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
55' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

54' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.

49' Augusto Batalla pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) fired on target from the rebound. His effort from inside the box was directed low to the middle of the goal.
47' Wow, what an escape. Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Juan Pulido blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' 1 - 2 Goal! Florian Lejeune plays a pass to the feet of Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:2.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
42' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' Juan Pulido blows his whistle after Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Rayo Vallecano are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
37' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) offside.
34' Celta Vigo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

34' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Good work from Celta Vigo as they win a corner.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
31' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
27' The referee blows for a cooling break.
26' None of the Celta Vigo players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
26' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
22' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
22' Celta Vigo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
22' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) fires a powerful shot which is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Celta Vigo will take a corner.
20' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
17' 1 - 1 Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the left post.
13' A rebound falls kindly for Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.
10' 1 - 0 Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Augusto Batalla to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
10' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
10' Handball! A player from Rayo Vallecano handled the ball. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Celta Vigo!
9' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Celta Vigo.
8' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
4' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
4' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.
3' Vicente Guaita is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Pacha (Rayo Vallecano). Easy save!
2' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

1' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
Juan Pulido will supervise the game today.
